note_only.reason: Tier-10 screener-bridged wire event, single origin (Outlook Business article citing one consultant, Anarock) with materiality_score 55 < gate 60. Per INTAKE.md §5, a single uncorroborated wire claim defaults to note_only unless a filing or a second independent source in the pool backs the same fact; no other new document landed in this intake window to corroborate it, and the claim itself (sentiment-driven dip, not structural) argues against a rerun.
